engaged_note: 164th Infantry and 1st Battalion, 7th Marines (Miller, ch. VI)
notes: Miller, chapter VI: the 29th Infantry made the first inland assault after midnight on 24–25 October and, with the 16th Infantry, pressed attacks until daylight on 26 October. This claim is the second night. Confidence 0.5. Miller lists Colonel Masajiro Furumiya, commanding the 29th, among the Japanese who penetrated the American lines and among the dead of the counter-offensive; a death-day claim is not added. Confidence is raised from 0.5 to 0.7. The 17th Army operations record independently confirms the 29th Infantry in the left-wing assault of 24–25 October and the decision to renew the attack on the night of the 25th, which agrees with Miller, chapter VI.
